ko.title: 평화상 발표의 금요일: 누가 노벨상을 받을 수 있을까, 그리고 그 선택이 전쟁 중인 세계에 던지는 메시지

segments.src: The Norwegian Nobel Committee is set to announce this year's Nobel Peace Prize on Friday in Oslo.
segments.tr: 노르웨이 노벨 위원회는 금요일 오슬로에서 올해의 노벨 평화상을 발표할 예정입니다.

segments.src: The announcement is one of the most closely watched moments on the global diplomatic calendar.
segments.tr: 이번 발표는 글로벌 외교 일정에서 가장 면밀히 주시되는 순간 중 하나입니다.

segments.src: It is also one of the hardest to predict.
segments.tr: 또한 가장 예측하기 어려운 일 중 하나이기도 합니다.

segments.src: This explainer covers how the decision is made, the kinds of candidates that tend to be discussed, and why past choices have often been read as political signals.
segments.tr: 이 설명서에서는 결정이 내려지는 방식, 주로 논의되는 후보의 유형, 그리고 과거의 선택이 왜 종종 정치적 신호로 해석되었는지에 대해 다룹니다.

segments.src: ## How the Prize Is Decided
segments.tr: ## 선정 방식

segments.src: The Peace Prize is the only Nobel awarded in Norway.
segments.tr: 평화상은 노르웨이에서 수여되는 유일한 노벨상입니다.

segments.src: The other prizes are announced in Stockholm.
segments.tr: 다른 상들은 스톡홀름에서 발표됩니다.

segments.src: The decision rests with a five-member committee appointed by the Norwegian Parliament.
segments.tr: 결정은 노르웨이 의회가 임명한 5인의 위원으로 구성된 위원회에 달려 있습니다.

segments.src: Its members work in secret.
segments.tr: 위원들은 비밀리에 활동합니다.

segments.src: Several rules shape the process:
segments.tr: 몇 가지 규칙이 이 과정을 규정합니다:

segments.src: - **Nominations are confidential for 50 years.** The committee does not publish the list of nominees, so any public "shortlist" is informed guesswork.
segments.tr: - **후보 추천은 50년간 기밀로 유지됩니다.** 위원회는 후보자 명단을 공개하지 않으므로, 대중에게 알려진 모든 "최종 후보 명단"은 근거 있는 추측에 불과합니다.

segments.src: - **Who can nominate.** Members of national parliaments and governments, university professors in relevant fields, past laureates, and certain other qualified people can submit names. Hundreds of nominations arrive each year, including both individuals and organizations.
segments.tr: - **추천 자격.** 각국 의회 및 정부 구성원, 관련 분야의 대학 교수, 역대 수상자, 그리고 기타 자격을 갖춘 특정 인물들이 이름을 제출할 수 있습니다. 매년 개인과 단체를 포함해 수백 건의 추천이 접수됩니다.

segments.src: - **The criteria come from Alfred Nobel's will.** The 1895 will refers to the person who has done the most or best work for "fraternity between nations," for the "abolition or reduction of standing armies," and for "the holding and promotion of peace congresses."
segments.tr: - **선정 기준은 알프레드 노벨의 유언에서 비롯됩니다.** 1895년의 유언장에는 "국가 간의 우애", "상비군의 폐지 또는 감축", 그리고 "평화 회의의 개최 및 촉진"을 위해 가장 많은 공헌을 했거나 가장 훌륭한 일을 한 인물을 언급하고 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Decisions are usually reached by consensus.** The committee tends to present its choice as a collective judgment rather than a split vote.
segments.tr: - **결정은 대개 합의를 통해 이루어집니다.** 위원회는 의견이 갈린 투표 결과보다는 공동의 판단으로 선택을 제시하는 경향이 있습니다.

segments.src: Because the process is closed, outside observers look to research institutes, past patterns and the news cycle.
segments.tr: 과정이 비공개로 진행되기 때문에 외부 관측통들은 연구 기관, 과거의 패턴, 뉴스 주기를 주목합니다.

segments.src: They do not have inside information.
segments.tr: 그들에게는 내부 정보가 없습니다.

segments.src: ## How the Committee Weighs Different Kinds of Work
segments.tr: ## 위원회가 다양한 형태의 공헌을 평가하는 방식

segments.src: Over its history, the committee has interpreted "peace" broadly.
segments.tr: 역사적으로 위원회는 "평화"를 넓은 의미로 해석해 왔습니다.

segments.src: Recent decades suggest several overlapping categories.
segments.tr: 최근 수십 년간의 경향은 몇 가지 중첩되는 범주를 보여줍니다.

segments.src: Direct peacemaking and diplomacy.** These are awards for negotiating ceasefires, brokering agreements or sustaining talks between adversaries.
segments.tr: 직접적인 평화 구축 및 외교.** 이는 휴전 협상, 합의 중재, 적대국 간의 회담 유지 등에 수여되는 상입니다.

segments.src: They can carry high stakes.
segments.tr: 이러한 상은 큰 위험을 수반할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: A prize given while a process is still unfolding may encourage the parties, but it can also look premature if the process later fails.
segments.tr: 평화 프로세스가 여전히 진행 중인 상황에서 수여되는 상은 당사자들을 독려할 수 있지만, 이후 프로세스가 실패할 경우 성급한 결정으로 보일 수도 있습니다.

segments.src: Humanitarian and relief work.** Organizations that feed, shelter or protect civilians in conflict zones have been honored repeatedly.
segments.tr: 인도주의 및 구호 활동.** 분쟁 지역에서 민간인에게 식량을 제공하고, 피난처를 제공하거나 보호하는 단체들이 반복적으로 수상해 왔습니다.

segments.src: The World Food Programme received the prize in 2020 for efforts to combat hunger as a weapon of war.
segments.tr: 세계식량계획(WFP)은 기아를 전쟁의 무기로 사용하는 것에 맞서 싸운 공로로 2020년에 평화상을 받았습니다.

segments.src: Human rights, press freedom and democratic institutions.** The committee has often argued that peace depends on open societies.
segments.tr: 인권, 언론의 자유 및 민주적 제도.** 위원회는 평화가 열린 사회에 달려 있다고 종종 주장해 왔습니다.

segments.src: Examples include the 2021 prize shared by journalists Maria Ressa and Dmitry Muratov, the 2022 prize shared by Ales Bialiatski with the organizations Memorial and the Center for Civil Liberties, and the 2023 prize for Narges Mohammadi.
segments.tr: 언론인 마리아 레사와 드미트리 무라토프가 공동 수상한 2021년 평화상, 알레스 비알리아츠키와 단체 메모리알, 시민자유센터가 공동 수상한 2022년 평화상, 그리고 나르게스 모하마디가 수상한 2023년 평화상이 그 예입니다.

segments.src: Arms control and disarmament.** This category follows directly from Nobel's will.
segments.tr: 군비 통제 및 군축.** 이 범주는 노벨의 유언에서 직접적으로 이어집니다.

segments.src: The 2017 prize went to the International Campaign to Abolish Nuclear Weapons, and the 2024 prize went to the Japanese atomic bomb survivors' organization Nihon Hidankyo, which has campaigned against the use of nuclear weapons.
segments.tr: 2017년 평화상은 핵무기폐기국제운동(ICAN)에 돌아갔고, 2024년 평화상은 핵무기 사용 반대 운동을 펼쳐온 일본의 원폭 피해자 단체인 니혼 히단쿄에 돌아갔습니다.

segments.src: Climate, development and "broader security."** Some awards treat environmental stress, poverty and inequality as underlying causes of conflict.
segments.tr: 기후, 개발 및 "광범위한 안보."** 일부 수상작은 환경적 스트레스, 빈곤, 불평등을 분쟁의 근본 원인으로 다룹니다.

segments.src: International cooperation and institutions.** The prize has gone to the United Nations, to its agencies and to the European Union (2012), reflecting the idea that durable peace rests on shared rules and institutions.
segments.tr: 국제 협력 및 기구.** 평화상은 유엔과 그 산하 기구들, 그리고 유럽연합(2012년)에 수여되었으며, 이는 지속 가능한 평화가 공유된 규칙과 제도에 기반한다는 생각을 반영합니다.

segments.src: ## The Kinds of Contenders Usually Discussed
segments.tr: ## 주로 논의되는 후보 유형

segments.src: In the days before the announcement, commentators typically point to a familiar set of candidates.
segments.tr: 발표를 며칠 앞두고 평론가들은 대개 익숙한 후보군을 지목합니다.

segments.src: Without naming favorites, since the nominee list is secret, the speculation tends to cluster around a few types:
segments.tr: 후보자 명단이 비밀이기 때문에 특정 유력 후보를 거론하지는 않지만, 추측은 대개 몇 가지 유형으로 좁혀집니다:

segments.src: - **Organizations documenting conflict and war crimes**, including investigators, courts and monitoring groups.
segments.tr: - 조사관, 법원, 감시 단체를 포함하여 **분쟁 및 전쟁 범죄를 기록하는 단체**.

segments.src: - **Humanitarian agencies and relief networks** working in active war zones and in disaster-hit regions.
segments.tr: - 실제 전쟁 지역과 재해 피해 지역에서 활동하는 **인도주의 기구 및 구호 네트워크**.

segments.src: - **Press-freedom and civil-society groups** operating under pressure in authoritarian settings.
segments.tr: - 권위주의적 환경에서 압박을 받으며 활동하는 **언론의 자유 및 시민사회 단체**.

segments.src: - **International bodies and their officials**, including those working on arms control, nuclear safeguards or refugee protection.
segments.tr: - 군비 통제, 핵 안전 조치 또는 난민 보호를 위해 일하는 기구를 포함한 **국제 기구 및 그 관계자들**.

segments.src: - **Diplomats and mediators** involved in recent negotiations, although the committee has historically been cautious about unfinished deals.
segments.tr: - 최근 협상에 관여한 **외교관 및 중재자들** (다만 위원회는 역사적으로 미완의 합의에 대해서는 신중한 태도를 보여왔습니다).

segments.src: - **Individual activists and dissidents**, some of them imprisoned or in exile.
segments.tr: - 일부는 수감되어 있거나 망명 중인 **개인 활동가 및 반체제 인사들**.

segments.src: Forecasts of this kind have a mixed record.
segments.tr: 이러한 종류의 예측은 맞을 때도 있고 틀릴 때도 있었습니다.

segments.src: The committee has often chosen laureates that few outside experts had singled out, and in some years the winner has been a surprise even to seasoned Nobel watchers.
segments.tr: 위원회는 외부 전문가들이 거의 주목하지 않았던 수상자를 선정하는 경우가 많았으며, 어떤 해에는 노련한 노벨상 관측통들에게조차 수상자가 뜻밖의 인물이었던 적도 있습니다.

segments.src: ## Why Past Choices Are Read as Political Signals
segments.tr: ## 과거의 선택이 정치적 신호로 해석되는 이유

segments.src: The committee insists that its decisions reflect Nobel's will, not foreign policy.
segments.tr: 위원회는 자신들의 결정이 외교 정책이 아닌 노벨의 유언을 반영한다고 주장합니다.

segments.src: Even so, the prize has often been interpreted as a message.
segments.tr: 그럼에도 불구하고 평화상은 종종 하나의 메시지로 해석되어 왔습니다.

segments.src: A few well-known episodes show why.
segments.tr: 잘 알려진 몇 가지 사례가 그 이유를 보여줍니다.

segments.src: - **1973.** The prize was awarded to U.S. Secretary of State Henry Kissinger and North Vietnam's Le Duc Tho for the Paris agreement on Vietnam. Le Duc Tho declined it, and the decision drew criticism and resignations from the committee. It remains a standard example of the risks of honoring an unfinished peace.
segments.tr: - **1973년.** 베트남에 관한 파리 협정을 이끈 공로로 헨리 키신저 미국 국무장관과 북베트남의 레둑토에게 상이 수여되었습니다. 레둑토는 수상을 거부했고, 이 결정은 위원회의 사퇴와 비판을 불러일으켰습니다. 이는 미완의 평화에 상을 주는 것이 얼마나 위험한지 보여주는 대표적인 사례로 남아 있습니다.

segments.src: - **2009.** Barack Obama received the prize early in his first term for "extraordinary efforts to strengthen international diplomacy." Supporters saw encouragement for a new approach. Critics asked whether it was too soon.
segments.tr: - **2009년.** 버락 오바마는 첫 임기 초반에 "국제 외교를 강화하기 위한 비상한 노력"으로 상을 받았습니다. 지지자들은 새로운 접근 방식에 대한 격려로 보았습니다. 비판론자들은 너무 이른 것이 아니냐고 물었습니다.

segments.src: - **2012.** The European Union was recognized for decades of contributions to peace and reconciliation in Europe, a choice many read as a statement about integration during a period of economic strain.
segments.tr: - **2012년.** 유럽연합은 유럽의 평화와 화해에 수십 년간 기여한 공로를 인정받았는데, 많은 이들은 이 선택을 경제적 긴장 시기에 통합을 옹호하는 선언으로 해석했습니다.

segments.src: - **2018.** Denis Mukwege and Nadia Murad were honored for efforts to end the use of sexual violence as a weapon of war, placing the issue squarely on the international agenda.
segments.tr: - **2018년.** 드니 무퀘게와 나디아 무라드는 전쟁의 무기로서 성폭력을 사용하는 것을 종식시키기 위한 노력으로 상을 받았으며, 이 문제를 국제적 의제로 확고히 부각시켰습니다.

segments.src: - **2021 to 2023.** A run of awards focused on press freedom and dissent. Many observers read these as a defense of civil liberties at a time of rising authoritarianism.
segments.tr: - **2021년~2023년.** 언론의 자유와 반체제 활동에 초점을 맞춘 수상작들이 이어졌습니다. 많은 관측통은 이를 권위주의가 고조되는 시기에 시민의 자유를 수호하려는 움직임으로 해석했습니다.

segments.src: - **2024.** The award to Nihon Hidankyo was widely seen as a reminder of the "nuclear taboo" amid renewed concern about nuclear weapons.
segments.tr: - **2024년.** 니혼 히단쿄에 대한 수여는 핵무기에 대한 우려가 다시 커지는 가운데 "핵 금기"를 상기시키는 조치로 널리 받아들여졌습니다.

segments.src: The pattern is not simply that the committee rewards the headline of the year.
segments.tr: 위원회는 단순히 그해의 헤드라인을 장식한 일에 상을 주는 것이 아닙니다.

segments.src: Often it looks for work that has quietly built a norm, such as the protection of civilians, the rejection of certain weapons or the importance of free information, and then amplifies it at a moment when that norm is under strain.
segments.tr: 종종 민간인 보호, 특정 무기의 거부, 자유로운 정보의 중요성 등 묵묵히 규범을 구축해 온 활동을 찾아내어, 그 규범이 위협받는 순간에 이를 널리 알리는 역할을 합니다.

segments.src: ## What This Year's Pick Could Signal
segments.tr: ## 올해의 선택이 보낼 수 있는 신호

segments.src: With multiple armed conflicts and heightened geopolitical tensions in the news, the committee faces a choice among several broad messages:
segments.tr: 여러 무력 충돌과 고조된 지정학적 긴장이 뉴스에 오르내리는 상황에서 위원회는 몇 가지 광범위한 메시지 중 하나를 선택해야 하는 상황에 직면해 있습니다:

segments.src: - **Back diplomacy.** Honoring negotiators or mediators would signal that dialogue deserves support even when outcomes remain uncertain.
segments.tr: - **외교 지지.** 협상가나 중재자에게 상을 주는 것은 결과가 여전히 불확실하더라도 대화가 지지받을 가치가 있다는 신호를 보낼 것입니다.

segments.src: - **Back humanitarian principles.** Recognizing relief groups, medical workers or investigators would emphasize the protection of civilians and respect for international law.
segments.tr: - **인도주의적 원칙 지지.** 구호 단체, 의료 종사자 또는 조사관을 인정하는 것은 민간인 보호와 국제법 존중을 강조하는 일이 될 것입니다.

segments.src: - **Back norms and institutions.** Honoring a body that supports arms control, justice or multilateral cooperation would speak to the health of the rules-based order.
segments.tr: - **규범 및 제도 지지.** 군비 통제, 정의 또는 다자간 협력을 지원하는 기구에 상을 주는 것은 규칙 기반 질서의 건전성을 대변할 것입니다.

segments.src: - **Back civil society.** Recognizing journalists, rights defenders or election monitors would stress that peace and open societies are linked.
segments.tr: - **시민사회 지지.** 언론인, 인권 옹호가 또는 선거 감시단을 인정하는 것은 평화와 열린 사회가 서로 연결되어 있음을 강조하는 일이 될 것입니다.

segments.src: Whichever path the committee takes, its explanation, delivered in the announcement and expanded in the formal citation, will matter as much as the name.
segments.tr: 위원회가 어떤 길을 택하든, 발표 시 전달되고 공식 인용문에서 확장될 위원회의 설명은 수상자의 이름만큼이나 중요할 것입니다.

segments.src: The reasoning is usually where the political message is most clearly stated.
segments.tr: 대개 그 논거에 정치적 메시지가 가장 명확하게 담겨 있기 때문입니다.

segments.src: ## What Happens After the Announcement
segments.tr: ## 발표 이후에 일어나는 일

segments.src: - The laureate or laureates are announced by the committee chair, typically in a short ceremony in Oslo.
segments.tr: - 수상자는 대개 오슬로에서 열리는 짧은 시상식에서 위원회 위원장에 의해 발표됩니다.

zh.title: 诺贝尔和平奖周五揭晓：谁能胜出，这一选择对战乱世界意味着什么

segments.src: The Norwegian Nobel Committee is set to announce this year's Nobel Peace Prize on Friday in Oslo.
segments.tr: 挪威诺贝尔委员会将于周五在奥斯陆宣布今年的诺贝尔和平奖得主。

segments.src: The announcement is one of the most closely watched moments on the global diplomatic calendar.
segments.tr: 这一宣布是全球外交日历上最受瞩目的时刻之一。

segments.src: It is also one of the hardest to predict.
segments.tr: 这也是最难预测的奖项之一。

segments.src: This explainer covers how the decision is made, the kinds of candidates that tend to be discussed, and why past choices have often been read as political signals.
segments.tr: 本文将介绍该奖项的评选机制、常被讨论的候选人类型，以及为什么过去的评选往往被解读为政治信号。

segments.src: ## How the Prize Is Decided
segments.tr: ## 奖项是如何决定的

segments.src: The Peace Prize is the only Nobel awarded in Norway.
segments.tr: 和平奖是唯一在挪威颁发的诺贝尔奖。

segments.src: The other prizes are announced in Stockholm.
segments.tr: 其他奖项则在斯德哥尔摩宣布。

segments.src: The decision rests with a five-member committee appointed by the Norwegian Parliament.
segments.tr: 该决定由挪威议会任命的五人委员会做出。

segments.src: Its members work in secret.
segments.tr: 其成员在保密状态下工作。

segments.src: Several rules shape the process:
segments.tr: 几项规则塑造了这一进程：

segments.src: - **Nominations are confidential for 50 years.** The committee does not publish the list of nominees, so any public "shortlist" is informed guesswork.
segments.tr: - **提名保密 50 年。** 委员会不会公布被提名人名单，因此任何公开的“候选名单”都只是知情猜测。

segments.src: - **Who can nominate.** Members of national parliaments and governments, university professors in relevant fields, past laureates, and certain other qualified people can submit names. Hundreds of nominations arrive each year, including both individuals and organizations.
segments.tr: - **谁可以提名。** 各国议会和政府成员、相关领域的大学教授、往届得主以及其他某些具备资格的人士可以提交人选。每年都会收到数百份提名，包括个人和组织。

segments.src: - **The criteria come from Alfred Nobel's will.** The 1895 will refers to the person who has done the most or best work for "fraternity between nations," for the "abolition or reduction of standing armies," and for "the holding and promotion of peace congresses."
segments.tr: - **标准源自阿尔弗雷德·诺贝尔的遗嘱。** 1895 年的遗嘱提到的是为“国家间友好”、为“废除或裁减常备军”以及为“组织和宣传和平会议”做出最多或最好工作的人。

segments.src: - **Decisions are usually reached by consensus.** The committee tends to present its choice as a collective judgment rather than a split vote.
segments.tr: - **决定通常通过协商一致达成。** 委员会倾向于将其选择表现为集体判断，而不是分裂的投票。

segments.src: Because the process is closed, outside observers look to research institutes, past patterns and the news cycle.
segments.tr: 由于评选过程是封闭的，外部观察人士通常会参考研究机构、以往的模式和新闻周期。

segments.src: They do not have inside information.
segments.tr: 他们没有内部消息。

segments.src: ## How the Committee Weighs Different Kinds of Work
segments.tr: ## 委员会如何权衡不同类型的工作

segments.src: Over its history, the committee has interpreted "peace" broadly.
segments.tr: 在其历史上，委员会对“和平”进行了广义的解释。

segments.src: Recent decades suggest several overlapping categories.
segments.tr: 近几十年的情况表明有几个重叠的类别。

segments.src: Direct peacemaking and diplomacy.** These are awards for negotiating ceasefires, brokering agreements or sustaining talks between adversaries.
segments.tr: 直接缔造和平与外交。** 这些是为谈判停火、斡旋协议或维持敌对双方对话而颁发的奖项。

segments.src: They can carry high stakes.
segments.tr: 它们可能具有很高的风险。

segments.src: A prize given while a process is still unfolding may encourage the parties, but it can also look premature if the process later fails.
segments.tr: 在进程仍在展开时颁发的奖项可能会鼓励各方，但如果该进程后来失败，这也可能显得为时过早。

segments.src: Humanitarian and relief work.** Organizations that feed, shelter or protect civilians in conflict zones have been honored repeatedly.
segments.tr: 人道主义与救援工作。** 在冲突地区为平民提供食物、住所或保护的组织多次受到表彰。

segments.src: The World Food Programme received the prize in 2020 for efforts to combat hunger as a weapon of war.
segments.tr: 世界粮食计划署因努力将饥饿作为战争武器进行斗争而获得 2020 年诺贝尔和平奖。

segments.src: Human rights, press freedom and democratic institutions.** The committee has often argued that peace depends on open societies.
segments.tr: 人权、新闻自由与民主机构。** 委员会经常认为和平依赖于开放的社会。

segments.src: Examples include the 2021 prize shared by journalists Maria Ressa and Dmitry Muratov, the 2022 prize shared by Ales Bialiatski with the organizations Memorial and the Center for Civil Liberties, and the 2023 prize for Narges Mohammadi.
segments.tr: 例如 2021 年由记者玛丽亚·雷萨和德米特里·穆拉托夫共同获得的奖项，2022 年由阿列斯·比亚利茨基与“纪念”组织和公民自由中心共同获得的奖项，以及 2023 年授予纳尔吉斯·穆罕默迪的奖项。

segments.src: Arms control and disarmament.** This category follows directly from Nobel's will.
segments.tr: 军备控制与裁军。** 这一类别直接遵循诺贝尔的遗嘱。

segments.src: The 2017 prize went to the International Campaign to Abolish Nuclear Weapons, and the 2024 prize went to the Japanese atomic bomb survivors' organization Nihon Hidankyo, which has campaigned against the use of nuclear weapons.
segments.tr: 2017 年的奖项授予了国际废除核武器运动，2024 年的奖项授予了日本原子弹爆炸受害者组织日本氢弹爆炸受害者团体协议会，该组织一直致力于反对使用核武器。

segments.src: Climate, development and "broader security."** Some awards treat environmental stress, poverty and inequality as underlying causes of conflict.
segments.tr: 气候、发展与“更广泛的安全”。** 一些奖项将环境压力、贫困和不平等视为冲突的根本原因。

segments.src: International cooperation and institutions.** The prize has gone to the United Nations, to its agencies and to the European Union (2012), reflecting the idea that durable peace rests on shared rules and institutions.
segments.tr: 国际合作与机构。** 该奖项曾授予联合国、其机构以及欧洲联盟（2012 年），这反映了持久和平建立在共同规则和机构之上的理念。

segments.src: ## The Kinds of Contenders Usually Discussed
segments.tr: ## 通常讨论的竞争者类型

segments.src: In the days before the announcement, commentators typically point to a familiar set of candidates.
segments.tr: 在宣布结果前几天，评论员通常会指出一组熟悉的候选人。

segments.src: Without naming favorites, since the nominee list is secret, the speculation tends to cluster around a few types:
segments.tr: 由于被提名人名单是保密的，在不点名最热门人选的情况下，各种猜测往往围绕以下几种类型：

segments.src: - **Organizations documenting conflict and war crimes**, including investigators, courts and monitoring groups.
segments.tr: - **记录冲突和战争罪行的组织**，包括调查人员、法庭和监督小组。

segments.src: - **Humanitarian agencies and relief networks** working in active war zones and in disaster-hit regions.
segments.tr: - 在活跃战区和灾害多发地区工作的**人道主义机构和救援网络**。

segments.src: - **Press-freedom and civil-society groups** operating under pressure in authoritarian settings.
segments.tr: - 在威权环境中承受压力的**新闻自由和公民社会团体**。

segments.src: - **International bodies and their officials**, including those working on arms control, nuclear safeguards or refugee protection.
segments.tr: - **国际机构及其官员**，包括从事军备控制、核保障或难民保护的人员。

segments.src: - **Diplomats and mediators** involved in recent negotiations, although the committee has historically been cautious about unfinished deals.
segments.tr: - 参与近期谈判的**外交官和调解员**，尽管委员会历来对尚未完成的协议保持谨慎。

segments.src: - **Individual activists and dissidents**, some of them imprisoned or in exile.
segments.tr: - **个人活动家和异见人士**，其中一些人被监禁或流亡。

segments.src: Forecasts of this kind have a mixed record.
segments.tr: 这类预测的准确率参差不齐。

segments.src: The committee has often chosen laureates that few outside experts had singled out, and in some years the winner has been a surprise even to seasoned Nobel watchers.
segments.tr: 委员会经常选择一些很少有外部专家选出的得主，在某些年份，获奖者甚至让经验丰富的诺贝尔观察家感到意外。

segments.src: ## Why Past Choices Are Read as Political Signals
segments.tr: ## 为什么过去的抉择被解读为政治信号

segments.src: The committee insists that its decisions reflect Nobel's will, not foreign policy.
segments.tr: 委员会坚称其决定反映了诺贝尔的遗嘱，而不是外交政策。

segments.src: Even so, the prize has often been interpreted as a message.
segments.tr: 即便如此，该奖项经常被解读为一种信息。

segments.src: A few well-known episodes show why.
segments.tr: 一些广为人知的事件说明了原因。

segments.src: - **1973.** The prize was awarded to U.S. Secretary of State Henry Kissinger and North Vietnam's Le Duc Tho for the Paris agreement on Vietnam. Le Duc Tho declined it, and the decision drew criticism and resignations from the committee. It remains a standard example of the risks of honoring an unfinished peace.
segments.tr: - **1973 年。** 该奖项授予美国国务卿亨利·基辛格和北越的黎德寿，以表彰他们达成关于越南问题的巴黎协定。黎德寿拒绝领奖，这一决定招致了批评和委员会成员的辞职。这仍然是表彰一个未完成的和平所带来风险的典型例子。

segments.src: - **2009.** Barack Obama received the prize early in his first term for "extraordinary efforts to strengthen international diplomacy." Supporters saw encouragement for a new approach. Critics asked whether it was too soon.
segments.tr: - **2009 年。** 巴拉克·奥巴马在其第一个任期之初因“为加强国际外交做出非凡努力”而获奖。支持者看到了对新方法的鼓励。批评者则质问是否为时过早。

segments.src: - **2012.** The European Union was recognized for decades of contributions to peace and reconciliation in Europe, a choice many read as a statement about integration during a period of economic strain.
segments.tr: - **2012 年。** 欧盟因数十年来对欧洲和平与和解的贡献而受到表彰，许多人将此选择解读为在经济压力时期关于一体化的表态。

segments.src: - **2018.** Denis Mukwege and Nadia Murad were honored for efforts to end the use of sexual violence as a weapon of war, placing the issue squarely on the international agenda.
segments.tr: - **2018 年。** 丹尼斯·姆韦格和纳迪亚·穆拉德因努力结束将性暴力用作战争武器而受到表彰，从而将这一问题明确置于国际议程上。

segments.src: - **2021 to 2023.** A run of awards focused on press freedom and dissent. Many observers read these as a defense of civil liberties at a time of rising authoritarianism.
segments.tr: - **2021 年至 2023 年。** 一系列奖项集中在新闻自由和异见上。许多观察家认为这是在威权主义抬头之际对公民自由的捍卫。

segments.src: - **2024.** The award to Nihon Hidankyo was widely seen as a reminder of the "nuclear taboo" amid renewed concern about nuclear weapons.
segments.tr: - **2024 年。** 授予日本氢弹爆炸受害者团体协议会的奖项被普遍视为在人们对核武器重新产生担忧之际对“核禁忌”的提醒。

segments.src: The pattern is not simply that the committee rewards the headline of the year.
segments.tr: 这种模式并不单单是委员会奖励年度头条新闻。

segments.src: Often it looks for work that has quietly built a norm, such as the protection of civilians, the rejection of certain weapons or the importance of free information, and then amplifies it at a moment when that norm is under strain.
segments.tr: 通常它寻找的是默默建立某种规范的工作，例如保护平民、拒绝某些武器或自由信息的重要性，然后在该规范受到压力时将其放大。

segments.src: ## What This Year's Pick Could Signal
segments.tr: ## 今年的选择可能释放什么信号

segments.src: With multiple armed conflicts and heightened geopolitical tensions in the news, the committee faces a choice among several broad messages:
segments.tr: 随着多起武装冲突和加剧的地缘政治紧张局势成为新闻，委员会面临着在几个广泛信息之间做出选择：

segments.src: - **Back diplomacy.** Honoring negotiators or mediators would signal that dialogue deserves support even when outcomes remain uncertain.
segments.tr: - **支持外交。** 荣誉授予谈判人员或调解员将发出信号，表明即使结果仍然不确定，对话也值得支持。

segments.src: - **Back humanitarian principles.** Recognizing relief groups, medical workers or investigators would emphasize the protection of civilians and respect for international law.
segments.tr: - **支持人道主义原则。** 承认救援组织、医疗工作者或调查人员将强调保护平民和尊重国际法。

segments.src: - **Back norms and institutions.** Honoring a body that supports arms control, justice or multilateral cooperation would speak to the health of the rules-based order.
segments.tr: - **支持规范与机构。** 表彰一个支持军备控制、正义或多边合作的机构将说明以规则为基础的秩序的健康状况。

segments.src: - **Back civil society.** Recognizing journalists, rights defenders or election monitors would stress that peace and open societies are linked.
segments.tr: - **支持公民社会。** 承认记者、人权卫士或选举观察员将强调和平与开放社会是紧密相连的。

segments.src: Whichever path the committee takes, its explanation, delivered in the announcement and expanded in the formal citation, will matter as much as the name.
segments.tr: 无论委员会走哪条路，其在宣布时发表并在正式褒奖令中展开的解释将与名字本身同样重要。

segments.src: The reasoning is usually where the political message is most clearly stated.
segments.tr: 政治信息通常在推理中阐述得最清楚。

segments.src: ## What Happens After the Announcement
segments.tr: ## 宣布之后会发生什么

segments.src: - The laureate or laureates are announced by the committee chair, typically in a short ceremony in Oslo.
segments.tr: - 获奖者由委员会主席宣布，通常在奥斯陆的一个简短仪式上进行。

segments.src: - The formal award ceremony takes place on December 10, the anniversary of Alfred Nobel's death. It includes a diploma, a gold medal and a monetary prize.
segments.tr: - 正式颁奖典礼于 12 月 10 日举行，即阿尔弗雷德·诺贝尔逝世纪念日。它包括一份文凭、一枚金牌和一笔奖金。

segments.src: - Laureates are invited to give a Nobel lecture. The speech often becomes a lasting statement of their cause.
segments.tr: - 获奖者应邀发表诺贝尔演讲。该演讲通常成为他们事业的持久宣言。

segments.src: ## Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## 底线

segments.src: The Nobel Peace Prize is an honor, an endorsement and a message all at once.
segments.tr: 诺贝尔和平奖既是一项荣誉、一种肯定，也是一条信息。

segments.src: The committee's deliberations are secret, and its history includes both widely praised and heavily criticized choices.
segments.tr: 委员会的审议是保密的，其历史既包括广受赞誉的选择，也包括饱受批评的选择。

segments.src: That is why each announcement draws such intense interest.
segments.tr: 这就是为什么每一次宣布都会引起如此浓厚的兴趣。

segments.src: Whoever is named on Friday, the choice will be read as a comment on what the committee believes peace requires in a world marked by conflict.
segments.tr: 无论周五宣布谁的名字，这一选择都将被解读为对委员会认为在一个充满冲突的世界中和平需要什么的看法。

segments.src: *This article is for general information.
segments.tr: *本文仅供一般参考。

segments.src: The committee's decision had not been announced at the time of writing, and any discussion of possible winners is speculative.*
segments.tr: 在撰写本文时，委员会的决定尚未宣布，对可能获奖者的任何讨论都是推测性的。*

segments.src: ## How the Prize Is Decided

segments.src: The Peace Prize is the only Nobel awarded in Norway.

segments.tr: अन्य पुरस्कारों की घोषणा स्टॉकहोम में की जाती है।

segments.src: The decision rests with a five-member committee appointed by the Norwegian Parliament.
segments.tr: यह निर्णय नॉर्वेजियन संसद द्वारा नियुक्त पांच सदस्यीय समिति के पास होता है।

segments.src: Its members work in secret.
segments.tr: इसके सदस्य गुप्त रूप से काम करते हैं।

segments.src: Several rules shape the process:
segments.tr: इस प्रक्रिया को कई नियम आकार देते हैं:

segments.src: - **Nominations are confidential for 50 years.** The committee does not publish the list of nominees, so any public "shortlist" is informed guesswork.
segments.tr: - **नामांकन 50 वर्षों तक गोपनीय रहते हैं।** समिति नामांकित व्यक्तियों की सूची प्रकाशित नहीं करती है, इसलिए कोई भी सार्वजनिक "शॉर्टलिस्ट" केवल अनुमानों पर आधारित होती है।

segments.src: - **Who can nominate.** Members of national parliaments and governments, university professors in relevant fields, past laureates, and certain other qualified people can submit names. Hundreds of nominations arrive each year, including both individuals and organizations.
segments.tr: - **कौन नामांकित कर सकता है।** राष्ट्रीय संसदों और सरकारों के सदस्य, संबंधित क्षेत्रों के विश्वविद्यालय प्रोफेसर, पिछले पुरस्कार विजेता और कुछ अन्य योग्य लोग नाम भेज सकते हैं। हर साल सैकड़ों नामांकन आते हैं, जिनमें व्यक्ति और संगठन दोनों शामिल होते हैं।

segments.src: - **The criteria come from Alfred Nobel's will.** The 1895 will refers to the person who has done the most or best work for "fraternity between nations," for the "abolition or reduction of standing armies," and for "the holding and promotion of peace congresses."
segments.tr: - **मानदंड अल्फ्रेड नोबेल की वसीयत से आते हैं।** 1895 की वसीयत उस व्यक्ति को संदर्भित करती है जिसने "राष्ट्रों के बीच भाईचारे," "स्थायी सेनाओं के उन्मूलन या कमी," और "शांति सम्मेलनों के आयोजन और प्रचार" के लिए सबसे अधिक या सबसे अच्छा काम किया हो।

segments.src: - **Decisions are usually reached by consensus.** The committee tends to present its choice as a collective judgment rather than a split vote.
segments.tr: - **निर्णय आमतौर पर आम सहमति से लिए जाते हैं।** समिति अपने चयन को विभाजित वोट के बजाय एक सामूहिक निर्णय के रूप में प्रस्तुत करना पसंद करती है।

segments.src: Because the process is closed, outside observers look to research institutes, past patterns and the news cycle.
segments.tr: चूंकि यह प्रक्रिया बंद होती है, इसलिए बाहरी पर्यवेक्षक अनुसंधान संस्थानों, पिछले पैटर्नों और समाचार चक्रों की ओर देखते हैं।

segments.src: They do not have inside information.
segments.tr: उनके पास कोई आंतरिक जानकारी नहीं होती है।

segments.src: ## How the Committee Weighs Different Kinds of Work
segments.tr: ## समिति विभिन्न प्रकार के कार्यों का मूल्यांकन कैसे करती है

segments.src: Over its history, the committee has interpreted "peace" broadly.
segments.tr: अपने इतिहास में, समिति ने "शांति" की व्यापक व्याख्या की है।

segments.src: Recent decades suggest several overlapping categories.
segments.tr: हाल के दशक कई परस्पर जुड़े हुए श्रेणियों का सुझाव देते हैं।

segments.src: Direct peacemaking and diplomacy.** These are awards for negotiating ceasefires, brokering agreements or sustaining talks between adversaries.
segments.tr: प्रत्यक्ष शांति स्थापना और कूटनीति।** ये युद्धविराम पर बातचीत करने, समझौतों की मध्यस्थता करने या विरोधियों के बीच बातचीत को बनाए रखने के लिए दिए जाने वाले पुरस्कार हैं।

segments.src: They can carry high stakes.
segments.tr: इनमें जोखिम बहुत अधिक हो सकता है।

segments.src: A prize given while a process is still unfolding may encourage the parties, but it can also look premature if the process later fails.
segments.tr: प्रक्रिया के जारी रहने के दौरान दिया गया पुरस्कार पक्षों को प्रोत्साहित कर सकता है, लेकिन यदि प्रक्रिया बाद में विफल हो जाती है, तो यह समय से पहले लिया गया निर्णय भी लग सकता है।

segments.src: Humanitarian and relief work.** Organizations that feed, shelter or protect civilians in conflict zones have been honored repeatedly.
segments.tr: मानवीय और राहत कार्य।** संघर्ष क्षेत्रों में नागरिकों को भोजन, आश्रय या सुरक्षा प्रदान करने वाले संगठनों को बार-बार सम्मानित किया गया है।

segments.src: The World Food Programme received the prize in 2020 for efforts to combat hunger as a weapon of war.
segments.tr: World Food Programme को 2020 में युद्ध के हथियार के रूप में भूख से निपटने के प्रयासों के लिए पुरस्कार मिला था।

segments.src: Human rights, press freedom and democratic institutions.** The committee has often argued that peace depends on open societies.
segments.tr: मानवाधिकार, प्रेस की स्वतंत्रता और लोकतांत्रिक संस्थान।** समिति ने अक्सर तर्क दिया है कि शांति खुले समाजों पर निर्भर करती है।

segments.src: Examples include the 2021 prize shared by journalists Maria Ressa and Dmitry Muratov, the 2022 prize shared by Ales Bialiatski with the organizations Memorial and the Center for Civil Liberties, and the 2023 prize for Narges Mohammadi.
segments.tr: उदाहरणों में पत्रकारों Maria Ressa और Dmitry Muratov द्वारा साझा किया गया 2021 का पुरस्कार, Ales Bialiatski द्वारा Memorial और Center for Civil Liberties संगठनों के साथ साझा किया गया 2022 का पुरस्कार, और Narges Mohammadi के लिए 2023 का पुरस्कार शामिल हैं।

segments.src: Arms control and disarmament.** This category follows directly from Nobel's will.
segments.tr: हथियार नियंत्रण और निरस्त्रीकरण।** यह श्रेणी सीधे नोबेल की वसीयत से जुड़ी है।

segments.src: The 2017 prize went to the International Campaign to Abolish Nuclear Weapons, and the 2024 prize went to the Japanese atomic bomb survivors' organization Nihon Hidankyo, which has campaigned against the use of nuclear weapons.
segments.tr: 2017 का पुरस्कार International Campaign to Abolish Nuclear Weapons को मिला था, और 2024 का पुरस्कार जापानी परमाणु बम पीड़ितों के संगठन Nihon Hidankyo को मिला, जिसने परमाणु हथियारों के उपयोग के खिलाफ अभियान चलाया है।

segments.src: Climate, development and "broader security."** Some awards treat environmental stress, poverty and inequality as underlying causes of conflict.
segments.tr: जलवायु, विकास और "व्यापक सुरक्षा।"** कुछ पुरस्कार पर्यावरणीय तनाव, गरीबी और असमानता को संघर्ष के अंतर्निहित कारणों के रूप में देखते हैं।

segments.src: International cooperation and institutions.** The prize has gone to the United Nations, to its agencies and to the European Union (2012), reflecting the idea that durable peace rests on shared rules and institutions.
segments.tr: अंतर्राष्ट्रीय सहयोग और संस्थान।** यह पुरस्कार संयुक्त राष्ट्र, उसकी एजेंसियों और यूरोपीय संघ (2012) को दिया गया है, जो इस विचार को दर्शाता है कि स्थायी शांति साझा नियमों और संस्थानों पर टिकी होती है।

segments.src: ## The Kinds of Contenders Usually Discussed
segments.tr: ## आमतौर पर चर्चा में रहने वाले दावेदार

segments.src: In the days before the announcement, commentators typically point to a familiar set of candidates.
segments.tr: घोषणा से कुछ दिन पहले, टिप्पणीकार आमतौर पर उम्मीदवारों के एक परिचित समूह की ओर इशारा करते हैं।

segments.src: Without naming favorites, since the nominee list is secret, the speculation tends to cluster around a few types:
segments.tr: पसंदीदा नामों का उल्लेख किए बिना, क्योंकि नामांकित व्यक्तियों की सूची गुप्त होती है, अटकलें आमतौर पर कुछ प्रकारों के इर्द-गिर्द घूमती हैं:

segments.src: - **Organizations documenting conflict and war crimes**, including investigators, courts and monitoring groups.
segments.tr: - **संघर्ष और युद्ध अपराधों का दस्तावेजीकरण करने वाले संगठन**, जिनमें जांचकर्ता, अदालतें और निगरानी समूह शामिल हैं।

segments.src: - **Humanitarian agencies and relief networks** working in active war zones and in disaster-hit regions.
segments.tr: - **मानवीय एजेंसियां और राहत नेटवर्क** जो सक्रिय युद्ध क्षेत्रों और आपदा प्रभावित क्षेत्रों में काम कर रहे हैं।

segments.src: - **Press-freedom and civil-society groups** operating under pressure in authoritarian settings.
segments.tr: - **प्रेस-स्वतंत्रता और नागरिक समाज समूह** जो सत्तावादी व्यवस्थाओं में दबाव के बीच काम कर रहे हैं।

segments.src: - **International bodies and their officials**, including those working on arms control, nuclear safeguards or refugee protection.
segments.tr: - **अंतर्राष्ट्रीय निकाय और उनके अधिकारी**, जिनमें हथियार नियंत्रण, परमाणु सुरक्षा या शरणार्थी संरक्षण पर काम करने वाले शामिल हैं।

segments.src: - **Diplomats and mediators** involved in recent negotiations, although the committee has historically been cautious about unfinished deals.
segments.tr: - **राजनयिक और मध्यस्थ** जो हाल की वार्ताओं में शामिल रहे हैं, हालांकि समिति ऐतिहासिक रूप से अधूरे समझौतों को लेकर सतर्क रही है।

segments.src: - **Individual activists and dissidents**, some of them imprisoned or in exile.
segments.tr: - **व्यक्तिगत कार्यकर्ता और असंतुष्ट**, जिनमें से कुछ जेल में हैं या निर्वासन में हैं।

segments.src: Forecasts of this kind have a mixed record.
segments.tr: इस तरह के पूर्वानुमानों का रिकॉर्ड मिला-जुला रहा है।

segments.src: The committee has often chosen laureates that few outside experts had singled out, and in some years the winner has been a surprise even to seasoned Nobel watchers.
segments.tr: समिति ने अक्सर ऐसे विजेताओं को चुना है जिन्हें बहुत कम बाहरी विशेषज्ञों ने चुना था, और कुछ वर्षों में विजेता का नाम अनुभवी नोबेल विश्लेषकों के लिए भी आश्चर्यचकित करने वाला रहा है।

segments.src: ## Why Past Choices Are Read as Political Signals
segments.tr: ## पिछले चयनों को राजनीतिक संकेतों के रूप में क्यों देखा जाता है

segments.src: The committee insists that its decisions reflect Nobel's will, not foreign policy.
segments.tr: समिति इस बात पर जोर देती है कि उसके निर्णय नोबेल की वसीयत को दर्शाते हैं, न कि विदेश नीति को।

segments.src: Even so, the prize has often been interpreted as a message.
segments.tr: फिर भी, इस पुरस्कार को अक्सर एक संदेश के रूप में व्याख्यायित किया गया है।

segments.src: A few well-known episodes show why.
segments.tr: कुछ प्रसिद्ध घटनाएं बताती हैं कि ऐसा क्यों है।

segments.src: - **1973.** The prize was awarded to U.S. Secretary of State Henry Kissinger and North Vietnam's Le Duc Tho for the Paris agreement on Vietnam. Le Duc Tho declined it, and the decision drew criticism and resignations from the committee. It remains a standard example of the risks of honoring an unfinished peace.
segments.tr: - **1973.** वियतनाम पर पेरिस समझौते के लिए अमेरिकी विदेश मंत्री Henry Kissinger और उत्तरी वियतनाम के Le Duc Tho को यह पुरस्कार दिया गया था। Le Duc Tho ने इसे अस्वीकार कर दिया था, और इस निर्णय के कारण समिति की आलोचना हुई और इस्तीफे भी हुए। यह अधूरी शांति को सम्मानित करने के जोखिमों का एक मानक उदाहरण बना हुआ है।

segments.src: - **2009.** Barack Obama received the prize early in his first term for "extraordinary efforts to strengthen international diplomacy." Supporters saw encouragement for a new approach. Critics asked whether it was too soon.
segments.tr: - **2009.** Barack Obama को उनके पहले कार्यकाल की शुरुआत में "अंतर्राष्ट्रीय कूटनीति को मजबूत करने के असाधारण प्रयासों" के लिए यह पुरस्कार मिला था। समर्थकों ने इसे एक नए दृष्टिकोण के लिए प्रोत्साहन के रूप में देखा। आलोचकों ने सवाल उठाया कि क्या यह बहुत जल्दबाजी थी।

segments.src: - **2012.** The European Union was recognized for decades of contributions to peace and reconciliation in Europe, a choice many read as a statement about integration during a period of economic strain.
segments.tr: - **2012.** यूरोपीय संघ को यूरोप में शांति और सुलह में दशकों के योगदान के लिए मान्यता दी गई थी, जिसे कई लोगों ने आर्थिक तनाव के दौर में एकीकरण के बारे में एक संदेश के रूप में देखा।

segments.src: - **2018.** Denis Mukwege and Nadia Murad were honored for efforts to end the use of sexual violence as a weapon of war, placing the issue squarely on the international agenda.
segments.tr: - **2018.** Denis Mukwege और Nadia Murad को युद्ध के हथियार के रूप में यौन हिंसा के उपयोग को समाप्त करने के प्रयासों के लिए सम्मानित किया गया, जिससे यह मुद्दा अंतर्राष्ट्रीय एजेंडे में प्रमुखता से शामिल हो गया।

segments.src: - **2021 to 2023.** A run of awards focused on press freedom and dissent. Many observers read these as a defense of civil liberties at a time of rising authoritarianism.
segments.tr: - **2021 से 2023.** पुरस्कारों की एक श्रृंखला प्रेस की स्वतंत्रता और असंतोष पर केंद्रित रही। कई पर्यवेक्षकों ने इन्हें बढ़ते सत्तावाद के समय में नागरिक स्वतंत्रता के बचाव के रूप में देखा।

segments.src: - **2024.** The award to Nihon Hidankyo was widely seen as a reminder of the "nuclear taboo" amid renewed concern about nuclear weapons.
segments.tr: - **2024.** Nihon Hidankyo को दिया गया पुरस्कार व्यापक रूप से परमाणु हथियारों के बारे में नए सिरे से चिंताओं के बीच "परमाणु निषेध" की याद दिलाने के रूप में देखा गया।

segments.src: The pattern is not simply that the committee rewards the headline of the year.
segments.tr: यह पैटर्न केवल यह नहीं है कि समिति वर्ष की मुख्य सुर्खियों को पुरस्कृत करती है।

segments.src: Often it looks for work that has quietly built a norm, such as the protection of civilians, the rejection of certain weapons or the importance of free information, and then amplifies it at a moment when that norm is under strain.
segments.tr: अक्सर यह ऐसे काम की तलाश करती है जिसने चुपचाप एक मानदंड का निर्माण किया हो, जैसे कि नागरिकों की सुरक्षा, कुछ हथियारों की अस्वीकृति या स्वतंत्र जानकारी का महत्व, और फिर उस क्षण में इसे बढ़ावा देती है जब वह मानदंड दबाव में हो।

segments.src: ## What This Year's Pick Could Signal
segments.tr: ## इस वर्ष का चयन क्या संकेत दे सकता है

segments.src: With multiple armed conflicts and heightened geopolitical tensions in the news, the committee faces a choice among several broad messages:
segments.tr: खबरों में कई सशस्त्र संघर्षों और बढ़ते भू-राजनीतिक तनावों के बीच, समिति के सामने कई व्यापक संदेशों में से चुनने का विकल्प है:

segments.src: - **Back diplomacy.** Honoring negotiators or mediators would signal that dialogue deserves support even when outcomes remain uncertain.
segments.tr: - **राजनय का समर्थन करें।** वार्ताकारों या मध्यस्थों को सम्मानित करना यह संकेत देगा कि परिणाम अनिश्चित होने पर भी संवाद समर्थन का हकदार है।

segments.src: - **Back humanitarian principles.** Recognizing relief groups, medical workers or investigators would emphasize the protection of civilians and respect for international law.
segments.tr: - **मानवीय सिद्धांतों का समर्थन करें।** राहत समूहों, चिकित्सा कर्मियों या जांचकर्ताओं को मान्यता देना नागरिकों की सुरक्षा और अंतर्राष्ट्रीय कानून के सम्मान पर जोर देगा।

segments.src: - **Back norms and institutions.** Honoring a body that supports arms control, justice or multilateral cooperation would speak to the health of the rules-based order.
segments.tr: - **मानदंडों और संस्थानों का समर्थन करें।** हथियार नियंत्रण, न्याय या बहुपक्षीय सहयोग का समर्थन करने वाले निकाय को सम्मानित करना नियम-आधारित व्यवस्था की स्थिति को बयां करेगा।

segments.src: - **Back civil society.** Recognizing journalists, rights defenders or election monitors would stress that peace and open societies are linked.
segments.tr: - **नागरिक समाज का समर्थन करें।** पत्रकारों, अधिकार कार्यकर्ताओं या चुनाव पर्यवेक्षकों को मान्यता देना इस बात पर जोर देगा कि शांति और खुले समाज आपस में जुड़े हुए हैं।

segments.src: Whichever path the committee takes, its explanation, delivered in the announcement and expanded in the formal citation, will matter as much as the name.
segments.tr: समिति जो भी रास्ता चुने, उसका स्पष्टीकरण, जो घोषणा में दिया जाता है और औपचारिक प्रशस्ति पत्र में विस्तारित किया जाता है, नाम जितना ही महत्वपूर्ण होगा।

segments.src: The reasoning is usually where the political message is most clearly stated.
segments.tr: तर्क आमतौर पर वह स्थान होता है जहां राजनीतिक संदेश सबसे स्पष्ट रूप से व्यक्त किया जाता है।

segments.src: ## What Happens After the Announcement
segments.tr: ## घोषणा के बाद क्या होता है

segments.tr: - विजेता या विजेताओं की घोषणा समिति के अध्यक्ष द्वारा की जाती है, आमतौर पर ओस्लो में एक संक्षिप्त समारोह में।

segments.src: ## Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## निष्कर्ष

segments.tr: नोबेल शांति पुरस्कार एक सम्मान, एक समर्थन और एक संदेश सब कुछ एक साथ है।

segments.tr: यही कारण है कि प्रत्येक घोषणा इतनी गहरी रुचि पैदा करती है।

es.title: Viernes del Premio de la Paz: quién podría ganar el Nobel y qué diría la elección sobre un mundo en guerra

segments.src: The Norwegian Nobel Committee is set to announce this year's Nobel Peace Prize on Friday in Oslo.
segments.tr: El Comité Noruego del Nobel anunciará este viernes en Oslo el Premio Nobel de la Paz de este año.

segments.src: The announcement is one of the most closely watched moments on the global diplomatic calendar.
segments.tr: El anuncio es uno de los momentos más seguidos del calendario diplomático mundial.

segments.src: It is also one of the hardest to predict.
segments.tr: También es uno de los más difíciles de predecir.

segments.src: This explainer covers how the decision is made, the kinds of candidates that tend to be discussed, and why past choices have often been read as political signals.
segments.tr: Este artículo explicativo aborda cómo se toma la decisión, el tipo de candidatos que se suelen debatir y por qué las elecciones pasadas a menudo se han interpretado como señales políticas.

segments.src: ## How the Prize Is Decided
segments.tr: ## Cómo se decide el premio

segments.src: The Peace Prize is the only Nobel awarded in Norway.
segments.tr: El Premio de la Paz es el único Nobel que se concede en Noruega.

segments.src: The other prizes are announced in Stockholm.
segments.tr: Los demás premios se anuncian en Estocolmo.

segments.src: The decision rests with a five-member committee appointed by the Norwegian Parliament.
segments.tr: La decisión recae en un comité de cinco miembros nombrados por el Parlamento noruego.

segments.src: Its members work in secret.
segments.tr: Sus miembros trabajan en secreto.

segments.src: Several rules shape the process:
segments.tr: El proceso se rige por varias normas:

segments.src: - **Nominations are confidential for 50 years.** The committee does not publish the list of nominees, so any public "shortlist" is informed guesswork.
segments.tr: - **Las nominaciones son confidenciales durante 50 años.** El comité no publica la lista de nominados, por lo que cualquier "lista de finalistas" pública es pura conjetura.

segments.src: - **Who can nominate.** Members of national parliaments and governments, university professors in relevant fields, past laureates, and certain other qualified people can submit names. Hundreds of nominations arrive each year, including both individuals and organizations.
segments.tr: - **Quién puede nominar.** Pueden proponer nombres los miembros de parlamentos y gobiernos nacionales, profesores universitarios de disciplinas pertinentes, galardonados en ediciones anteriores y otras personas cualificadas. Cada año se reciben cientos de nominaciones, que incluyen tanto a personas como a organizaciones.

segments.src: - **The criteria come from Alfred Nobel's will.** The 1895 will refers to the person who has done the most or best work for "fraternity between nations," for the "abolition or reduction of standing armies," and for "the holding and promotion of peace congresses."
segments.tr: - **Los criterios proceden del testamento de Alfred Nobel.** El testamento de 1895 se refiere a la persona que haya realizado el mayor o mejor trabajo por la "fraternidad entre las naciones", por la "abolición o reducción de los ejércitos permanentes" y por la "celebración y promoción de congresos de paz".

segments.src: - **Decisions are usually reached by consensus.** The committee tends to present its choice as a collective judgment rather than a split vote.
segments.tr: - **Las decisiones suelen tomarse por consenso.** El comité tiende a presentar su elección como un juicio colectivo y no como una votación dividida.

segments.src: Because the process is closed, outside observers look to research institutes, past patterns and the news cycle.
segments.tr: Al tratarse de un proceso cerrado, los observadores externos recurren a institutos de investigación, a patrones del pasado y a la actualidad informativa.

segments.src: They do not have inside information.
segments.tr: No disponen de información privilegiada.

segments.src: ## How the Committee Weighs Different Kinds of Work
segments.tr: ## Cómo valora el Comité los distintos tipos de labor

segments.src: Over its history, the committee has interpreted "peace" broadly.
segments.tr: A lo largo de su historia, el comité ha interpretado la "paz" en un sentido amplio.

segments.src: Recent decades suggest several overlapping categories.
segments.tr: Las últimas décadas sugieren varias categorías que se solapan.

segments.src: Direct peacemaking and diplomacy.** These are awards for negotiating ceasefires, brokering agreements or sustaining talks between adversaries.
segments.tr: Pacificación directa y diplomacia.** Se trata de premios por negociar altos el fuego, mediar en acuerdos o mantener conversaciones entre adversarios.

segments.src: They can carry high stakes.
segments.tr: Pueden entrañar un gran riesgo.

segments.src: A prize given while a process is still unfolding may encourage the parties, but it can also look premature if the process later fails.
segments.tr: Un premio concedido mientras un proceso está aún en marcha puede alentar a las partes, pero también puede parecer prematuro si el proceso fracasa posteriormente.

segments.src: Humanitarian and relief work.** Organizations that feed, shelter or protect civilians in conflict zones have been honored repeatedly.
segments.tr: Labor humanitaria y de socorro.** Las organizaciones que alimentan, refugian o protegen a civiles en zonas de conflicto han sido galardonadas en repetidas ocasiones.

segments.src: The World Food Programme received the prize in 2020 for efforts to combat hunger as a weapon of war.
segments.tr: El Programa Mundial de Alimentos recibió el premio en 2020 por sus esfuerzos para combatir el hambre como arma de guerra.

segments.src: Human rights, press freedom and democratic institutions.** The committee has often argued that peace depends on open societies.
segments.tr: Derechos humanos, libertad de prensa e instituciones democráticas.** El comité ha sostenido a menudo que la paz depende de las sociedades abiertas.

segments.src: Examples include the 2021 prize shared by journalists Maria Ressa and Dmitry Muratov, the 2022 prize shared by Ales Bialiatski with the organizations Memorial and the Center for Civil Liberties, and the 2023 prize for Narges Mohammadi.
segments.tr: Ejemplos de ello son el premio de 2021 compartido por los periodistas Maria Ressa y Dmitry Muratov, el de 2022 compartido por Ales Bialiatski con las organizaciones Memorial y el Centro para las Libertades Civiles, y el de 2023 para Narges Mohammadi.

segments.src: Arms control and disarmament.** This category follows directly from Nobel's will.
segments.tr: Control de armas y desarme.** Esta categoría se deriva directamente del testamento de Nobel.

segments.src: The 2017 prize went to the International Campaign to Abolish Nuclear Weapons, and the 2024 prize went to the Japanese atomic bomb survivors' organization Nihon Hidankyo, which has campaigned against the use of nuclear weapons.
segments.tr: El premio de 2017 fue para la Campaña Internacional para Abolir las Armas Nucleares, y el de 2024 para la organización japonesa de supervivientes de la bomba atómica Nihon Hidankyo, que ha hecho campaña contra el uso de armas nucleares.

segments.src: Climate, development and "broader security."** Some awards treat environmental stress, poverty and inequality as underlying causes of conflict.
segments.tr: Clima, desarrollo y "seguridad en un sentido más amplio".** Algunos galardones consideran que el deterioro medioambiental, la pobreza y la desigualdad son causas subyacentes de los conflictos.

segments.src: International cooperation and institutions.** The prize has gone to the United Nations, to its agencies and to the European Union (2012), reflecting the idea that durable peace rests on shared rules and institutions.
segments.tr: Cooperación e instituciones internacionales.** El premio ha recaído en las Naciones Unidas, en sus organismos y en la Unión Europea (2012), reflejando la idea de que una paz duradera se apoya en normas e instituciones compartidas.

segments.src: ## The Kinds of Contenders Usually Discussed
segments.tr: ## El tipo de candidatos que se suelen debatir

segments.src: In the days before the announcement, commentators typically point to a familiar set of candidates.
segments.tr: En los días previos al anuncio, los analistas suelen señalar a un grupo habitual de candidatos.

segments.src: Without naming favorites, since the nominee list is secret, the speculation tends to cluster around a few types:
segments.tr: Sin nombrar favoritos, dado que la lista de nominados es secreta, las especulaciones suelen agruparse en torno a unos pocos perfiles:

segments.src: - **Organizations documenting conflict and war crimes**, including investigators, courts and monitoring groups.
segments.tr: - **Organizaciones que documentan conflictos y crímenes de guerra**, incluidos investigadores, tribunales y grupos de supervisión.

segments.src: - **Humanitarian agencies and relief networks** working in active war zones and in disaster-hit regions.
segments.tr: - **Organizaciones humanitarias y redes de socorro** que trabajan en zonas de guerra activas y en regiones afectadas por catástrofes.

segments.src: - **Press-freedom and civil-society groups** operating under pressure in authoritarian settings.
segments.tr: - **Grupos de defensa de la libertad de prensa y de la sociedad civil** que operan bajo presión en entornos autoritarios.

segments.src: - **International bodies and their officials**, including those working on arms control, nuclear safeguards or refugee protection.
segments.tr: - **Organismos internacionales y sus funcionarios**, incluidos los que trabajan en el control de armas, las salvaguardias nucleares o la protección de los refugiados.

segments.src: - **Diplomats and mediators** involved in recent negotiations, although the committee has historically been cautious about unfinished deals.
segments.tr: - **Diplomáticos y mediadores** implicados en negociaciones recientes, aunque históricamente el comité se ha mostrado cauteloso ante acuerdos inacabados.

segments.src: - **Individual activists and dissidents**, some of them imprisoned or in exile.
segments.tr: - **Activistas individuales y disidentes**, algunos de ellos encarcelados o en el exilio.

segments.src: Forecasts of this kind have a mixed record.
segments.tr: Los pronósticos de este tipo tienen un historial irregular.

segments.src: The committee has often chosen laureates that few outside experts had singled out, and in some years the winner has been a surprise even to seasoned Nobel watchers.
segments.tr: A menudo, el comité ha elegido a galardonados que pocos expertos externos habían señalado, y en algunos años el ganador ha sido una sorpresa incluso para los observadores más experimentados del Nobel.

segments.src: ## Why Past Choices Are Read as Political Signals
segments.tr: ## Por qué las elecciones pasadas se interpretan como señales políticas

segments.src: The committee insists that its decisions reflect Nobel's will, not foreign policy.
segments.tr: El comité insiste en que sus decisiones reflejan el testamento de Nobel, no la política exterior.

segments.src: Even so, the prize has often been interpreted as a message.
segments.tr: Aun así, el premio se ha interpretado a menudo como un mensaje.

segments.src: A few well-known episodes show why.
segments.tr: Algunos episodios conocidos muestran el porqué.

segments.src: - **1973.** The prize was awarded to U.S. Secretary of State Henry Kissinger and North Vietnam's Le Duc Tho for the Paris agreement on Vietnam. Le Duc Tho declined it, and the decision drew criticism and resignations from the committee. It remains a standard example of the risks of honoring an unfinished peace.
segments.tr: - **1973.** El premio fue concedido al Secretario de Estado estadounidense Henry Kissinger y al norvietnamita Le Duc Tho por el acuerdo de París sobre Vietnam. Le Duc Tho lo rechazó, y la decisión suscitó críticas y dimisiones en el comité. Sigue siendo un ejemplo clásico de los riesgos de galardonar una paz inacabada.

segments.src: - **2009.** Barack Obama received the prize early in his first term for "extraordinary efforts to strengthen international diplomacy." Supporters saw encouragement for a new approach. Critics asked whether it was too soon.
segments.tr: - **2009.** Barack Obama recibió el premio al principio de su primer mandato por sus "extraordinarios esfuerzos para fortalecer la diplomacia internacional". Sus partidarios lo vieron como un estímulo para un nuevo enfoque. Los críticos se preguntaron si era demasiado pronto.

segments.src: - **2012.** The European Union was recognized for decades of contributions to peace and reconciliation in Europe, a choice many read as a statement about integration during a period of economic strain.
segments.tr: - **2012.** Se reconoció a la Unión Europea por décadas de contribución a la paz y la reconciliación en Europa, una elección que muchos interpretaron como una declaración sobre la integración en un periodo de tensiones económicas.

segments.src: - **2018.** Denis Mukwege and Nadia Murad were honored for efforts to end the use of sexual violence as a weapon of war, placing the issue squarely on the international agenda.
segments.tr: - **2018.** Denis Mukwege y Nadia Murad fueron galardonados por sus esfuerzos para acabar con el uso de la violencia sexual como arma de guerra, situando esta cuestión de lleno en la agenda internacional.

segments.src: - **2021 to 2023.** A run of awards focused on press freedom and dissent. Many observers read these as a defense of civil liberties at a time of rising authoritarianism.
segments.tr: - **2021 a 2023.** Una serie de premios centrados en la libertad de prensa y la disidencia. Muchos observadores los interpretaron como una defensa de las libertades civiles en un momento de creciente autoritarismo.

segments.src: - **2024.** The award to Nihon Hidankyo was widely seen as a reminder of the "nuclear taboo" amid renewed concern about nuclear weapons.
segments.tr: - **2024.** La concesión del premio a Nihon Hidankyo fue vista mayoritariamente como un recordatorio del "tabú nuclear" en medio de una renovada preocupación por las armas nucleares.

segments.src: The pattern is not simply that the committee rewards the headline of the year.
segments.tr: El patrón no consiste simplemente en que el comité premie la noticia del año.

segments.src: Often it looks for work that has quietly built a norm, such as the protection of civilians, the rejection of certain weapons or the importance of free information, and then amplifies it at a moment when that norm is under strain.
segments.tr: A menudo busca una labor que haya ido construyendo silenciosamente una norma, como la protección de los civiles, el rechazo de ciertas armas o la importancia de la información libre, y luego la amplifica en un momento en que dicha norma se encuentra bajo presión.

segments.src: ## What This Year's Pick Could Signal
segments.tr: ## Qué podría señalar la elección de este año

segments.src: With multiple armed conflicts and heightened geopolitical tensions in the news, the committee faces a choice among several broad messages:
segments.tr: Con múltiples conflictos armados y una elevada tensión geopolítica en las noticias, el comité se enfrenta a la elección entre varios mensajes generales:

segments.src: - **Back diplomacy.** Honoring negotiators or mediators would signal that dialogue deserves support even when outcomes remain uncertain.
segments.tr: - **Apoyar la diplomacia.** Galardonar a negociadores o mediadores indicaría que el diálogo merece apoyo incluso cuando los resultados siguen siendo inciertos.

segments.src: - **Back humanitarian principles.** Recognizing relief groups, medical workers or investigators would emphasize the protection of civilians and respect for international law.
segments.tr: - **Apoyar los principios humanitarios.** Reconocer a grupos de socorro, personal médico o investigadores haría hincapié en la protección de los civiles y el respeto al derecho internacional.

segments.src: - **Back norms and institutions.** Honoring a body that supports arms control, justice or multilateral cooperation would speak to the health of the rules-based order.
segments.tr: - **Apoyar las normas e instituciones.** Premiar a un organismo que apoye el control de armas, la justicia o la cooperación multilateral hablaría en favor de la salud del orden basado en normas.

segments.src: - **Back civil society.** Recognizing journalists, rights defenders or election monitors would stress that peace and open societies are linked.
segments.tr: - **Apoyar a la sociedad civil.** Reconocer a periodistas, defensores de los derechos o supervisores electorales recalcaría que la paz y las sociedades abiertas están vinculadas.

segments.src: Whichever path the committee takes, its explanation, delivered in the announcement and expanded in the formal citation, will matter as much as the name.
segments.tr: Sea cual sea el camino que tome el comité, su explicación, ofrecida en el anuncio y ampliada en la mención oficial, importará tanto como el nombre.

segments.src: The reasoning is usually where the political message is most clearly stated.
segments.tr: La argumentación suele ser el lugar donde se expone con mayor claridad el mensaje político.

segments.src: ## What Happens After the Announcement
segments.tr: ## Qué ocurre tras el anuncio

segments.tr: - El galardonado o galardonados son anunciados por el presidente del comité, normalmente en una breve ceremonia en Oslo.

segments.src: - The formal award ceremony takes place on December 10, the anniversary of Alfred Nobel's death. It includes a diploma, a gold medal and a monetary prize.
segments.tr: - La ceremonia oficial de entrega de premios tiene lugar el 10 de diciembre, aniversario de la muerte de Alfred Nobel. Incluye un diploma, una medalla de oro y un premio en metálico.

segments.tr: - Se invita a los galardonados a pronunciar un discurso de aceptación del Nobel. El discurso suele convertirse en una declaración duradera de su causa.

segments.src: ## Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## Conclusión

segments.src: The Nobel Peace Prize is an honor, an endorsement and a message all at once.
segments.tr: El Premio Nobel de la Paz es un honor, un respaldo y un mensaje, todo a la vez.

segments.src: The committee's deliberations are secret, and its history includes both widely praised and heavily criticized choices.
segments.tr: Las deliberaciones del comité son secretas, y su historia incluye elecciones tanto muy elogiadas como fuertemente criticadas.

segments.src: That is why each announcement draws such intense interest.
segments.tr: Por eso cada anuncio despierta un interés tan intenso.

segments.src: Whoever is named on Friday, the choice will be read as a comment on what the committee believes peace requires in a world marked by conflict.
segments.tr: Sea quien sea el designado el viernes, la elección se interpretará como un comentario sobre lo que el comité cree que requiere la paz en un mundo marcado por el conflicto.

segments.src: ## How the Prize Is Decided
